# Munari

> Munari renders live, interactive DOM as physical matter in Three.js. It uses Chrome's experimental HTML-in-Canvas API and keeps the DOM as the source of truth.

## Start

- [README and current setup](https://github.com/petekp/munari/blob/main/README.md)
- [Munari agent skill](https://github.com/petekp/munari/blob/main/.agents/skills/munari/SKILL.md)
- [DOM authoring rules](https://github.com/petekp/munari/blob/main/docs/authoring.md)
- [Public React API](https://github.com/petekp/munari/blob/main/packages/react/src/index.ts)
